name: Consolidated Grunenfelder Saady Holding Company
summary: Consolidated Grunenfelder Saady Holding Company specializes in the production of diverse refrigeration and cold-storage systems. Its product portfolio includes temperature-regulated logistics vehicles, comprehensive industrial and commercial cooling solutions, and portable cold storage units. Furthermore, the company develops offerings such as telecommunications solutions, offshore and land-based containers, mobile medical clinics, and specialized defense and automotive systems. Their clientele encompasses a broad spectrum of industries, including agriculture, telecommunications, dairy, poultry and general farming, aquaculture, the food and beverage sector, and quick-service restaurant chains. The firm was established in 1976 and maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
